extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to the U.S. DOE Energy Frontier Research Centers (EFRC) FOA (research institutions, universities, national labs, consortia)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting a proposal (pre-application and full application) in response to DOE FOA DE-FOA-0002653 for Energy Frontier Research Centers, following the announcement's procedural, format, and submission requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-Application required
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-Applications must be submitted by the stated deadline: Submission Deadline for Pre-Applications: February 15, 2022 at 5:00PM Eastern Time. Pre-Application Response Date: March 22, 2022. Prospective applicants must complete the pre-application step to be eligible to submit a full application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application submission deadline and non-extension
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission Deadline for Applications: May 3, 2022 at 11:59PM Eastern Time
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The application due date will NOT be extended as a result of Amendment No. 000001. Applicants must ensure their complete applications are submitted by 11:59 PM ET on May 3, 2022; late submissions will not be accommodated due to this non-extension statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excel tables submission by email at both stages
rubrics_metrics.description: At both the pre-application and application stage the FOA requires submission of tables in Excel format by email to EFRC.FOA@science.doe.gov
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific tables (e.g., collaborator, budget, reports-addressed) must be provided in Excel and emailed to the specified address at both stages. Follow the FOA's required table formats and include any requested metadata or identifiers so the DOE can associate the tables with the corresponding pre-application or application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of provided EFRC FOA templates and supporting materials
rubrics_metrics.description: EFRC FOA Collaborator Template; EFRC FOA Budget Template; EFRC FOA Reports Addressed Template; EFRC FOA Webinar Slides and Video are provided
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should use the provided templates for collaborator information, budgets, and reports-addressed tables to ensure submissions conform to FOA expectations. Review webinar slides and video for guidance on completing forms and meeting FOA requirements. Templates likely define required fields and formats for submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to review FOA amendments and full announcement
rubrics_metrics.description: The entire Funding Opportunity Announcement (FOA), including the actual revisions made by Amendment No. 000001, should be carefully reviewed by all prospective applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendment summaries are provided on the FOA page, but applicants must read the full FOA and all amendment text to identify changes affecting submission, content, deadlines, or required materials. Do not rely solely on summary descriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment change: Science for Clean Energy Reports link updated
rubrics_metrics.description: In Section I, under 'Science for Clean Energy Reports', the previous link to a brochure for 'BES Roundtable on Foundational Science for Carbon-Neutral Hydrogen Technologies' is replaced with a link to the full report of the same name, which is now available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants referencing or aligning proposals to the BES roundtable outputs should use the full report (link updated) rather than the prior brochure; incorporate any relevant findings or priorities from the full report into the proposal narrative where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment change: Questions due date specified
rubrics_metrics.description: In Section VII, under A. Questions, the previous reference to the due date for questions is changed to specify '12:00 Noon Eastern Time on April 29, 2022.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All technical and administrative questions about the FOA must be submitted by the stated cutoff (12:00 Noon ET, April 29, 2022) to be considered. Allow time for institutional review before submitting questions and check amendment text for any further clarifications.
